id: 28_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder – How to change different nozzle
title: 激光焊接机更换清洗嘴（国内版）
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/28_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder – How to change different nozzle.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/28_xTool MetalFab Laser Welder – How to change different nozzle（国内版）/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣举着一把焊枪，旁边摆着两种不同形状的喷嘴
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a handheld laser welding gun beside two differently shaped brass nozzles on the bench.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：焊接嘴怎样换成清洗嘴。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换清洗嘴

shots.scene: 阿杰刚焊完，伸手就去拧焊嘴
shots.prompt_en: The young male student has just finished welding and reaches with a bare hand to unscrew the nozzle.
shots.narration: 阿杰刚焊完，想马上换嘴去清洗焊缝。

shots.scene: 焊嘴冒着热气，阿杰缩回手
shots.prompt_en: Heat waves rise from the nozzle and the young male student pulls his hand back quickly.
shots.narration: 焊嘴还烫着，机器也没关。

shots.scene: 老李走过来，示意他先等一等
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks over and gestures for him to wait.
shots.narration: 老李说：换嘴有顺序，别急。

shots.scene: 老李按下主机背面的电源开关到关闭
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the rocker switch on the back of the main unit to off.
shots.narration: 第一步，关闭设备电源。

shots.scene: 屏幕熄灭、指示灯熄灭，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen and indicator light go dark, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 确认屏幕和指示灯都灭了。

shots.scene: 焊嘴旁的热浪图标和高温警示
shots.prompt_en: Icon of heat waves rising from a welding nozzle with a hot surface warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 刚用完的焊嘴很烫，

shots.scene: 焊枪挂在支架上，旁边一个沙漏
shots.prompt_en: The welding gun rests on its cradle with an hourglass beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 先挂回支架，等它冷却。

shots.scene: 老李戴上皮革耐热手套
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts on thick leather heat-resistant gloves.
shots.narration: 动手时戴好耐热手套。

shots.scene: 老李从焊枪头上取下送丝管
shots.prompt_en: Wearing heat-resistant gloves, the facility engineer opens the clamp and removes the wire feeding tube from the gun.
shots.narration: 第二步，拆下送丝管。

shots.scene: 送丝管放在一旁，焊丝头朝下
shots.prompt_en: The wire feeding tube is set aside on the bench with its wire tip pointing down. No people.
shots.narration: 清洗用不到送丝，送丝管先放好。

shots.scene: 老李拧下焊枪头上的铜色焊接嘴
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer unscrews the copper welding nozzle from the tip of the welding gun.
shots.narration: 第三步，拆下焊接嘴。

shots.scene: 焊接嘴放进一个分格的喷嘴盒
shots.prompt_en: The welding nozzle is placed into a compartment of a small nozzle storage box. No people.
shots.narration: 拆下的焊嘴放进喷嘴盒，不随手乱放。

shots.scene: 老李拿起清洗嘴，对着灯检查
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a cleaning nozzle up to the light and inspects it.
shots.narration: 装之前，先看看清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 变形、烧蚀、堵塞的喷嘴图标，都被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a bent nozzle, a burned nozzle and a clogged nozzle, all crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 变形、烧蚀、堵塞的，不能用。

shots.scene: 老李把清洗嘴拧到焊枪头上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer screws the cleaning nozzle onto the welding gun tip.
shots.narration: 第四步，换上清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 清洗嘴拧到位，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: Close view: the cleaning nozzle is fully seated on the gun tip, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 拧紧到位，不松不歪。

shots.scene: 清洗嘴图标和屏幕清洗模式图标用线连起来
shots.prompt_en: A line links a cleaning nozzle icon to a cleaning mode icon on a touch screen; a welding nozzle links to a welding mode icon. No people.
shots.narration: 换了清洗嘴，屏幕上就要选清洗模式。

shots.scene: 嘴和模式错配，喷嘴冒烟的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a mismatched nozzle and mode with smoke coming from the nozzle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 嘴和模式不对应，可能烧坏喷嘴。

shots.scene: 老李开机后核对屏幕上的模式
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches the machine back on and checks the selected mode on the touch screen.
shots.narration: 开机后先核对模式，再开出光。

shots.scene: 清洗时光斑在锈面上来回扫的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a laser spot sweeps back and forth over a rusty metal surface, sending up a cloud of particles. No people.
shots.narration: 激光清洗的光在表面来回扫，

shots.scene: 扫描光反射到四周的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: reflected beams scatter in several directions from the swept surface. No people.
shots.narration: 反射方向更难预料，还会扬起锈和涂层粉尘。

shots.scene: 老李戴面罩、呼吸防护，排风罩对着工件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears a laser face shield and a respirator while a fume extraction hood points at the workpiece.
shots.narration: 防护眼镜、呼吸防护、排风，一样不少。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着封面有激光标志的空白小册子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank booklet with a laser warning pictogram on the cover.
shots.narration: 要求以现行国家标准和本校规定为准。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后四个步骤图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the welding gun with four step icons behind: a power switch off, a tube, a nozzle out and a nozzle in.
shots.narration: 关机、拆管、拆焊嘴、装清洗嘴。

shots.scene: 图标：冷却、检查、对模式、防护
shots.prompt_en: Icons in a row: an hourglass, a magnifier on a nozzle, a nozzle linked to a mode, and a face shield. No people.
shots.narration: 等冷却，查喷嘴，对模式，做防护。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 换嘴虽小，规矩不少。下次见！
